newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Kabila authorities release Tshisekedi.
newsitem.headline: Kabila authorities release Tshisekedi.

text.p: Veteran opposition leader Etienne Tshisekedi was released on Friday, the morning after soldiers from Laurent Kabila's army arrested him at his home, a senior aide said.

Adrien Phongo, secretary general of Tshisekedi's Union for Democracy and Social Progress (UDPS) party, said Tshisekedi had been released along with members of his family and other supporters arrested with him.
"He was questioned for a long time. We are disappointed. They want to light the fire," he told Reuters.
Tshisekedi, the main domestic opponent to toppled veteran dictator Mobutu Sese Seko, was arrested late on Thursday after addressing a student gathering in defiance of a ban on political activity.
Witnesses said his arrest triggered protests by Tshisekedi loyalists who set fire to at least four vehicles in his Limete district of the capital Kinshasa.
